spanish: Todas las colgaduras del atrio alrededor de lino fino retorcido.

findings.issue: Unmarked “de” joins absolute סָבִיב to שֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר, so the hangings stand around the linen. סָבִיב locates the hangings of the court; שֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר is the verbless predicate, fine twisted linen.

notes: כל through החצר and the hophal participle are otherwise represented.
